xp.title: Experiments
xp.sub: A/B tests: half of the visitors (or the share you choose) see version B of the shop, and the result shows which one more people buy from.
xp.note: A test changes only words and which parts of a page show. Prices, discounts, COD and delivery charges are never tested this way — those need the owner's written OK.
xp.none: No test yet. Write one with New test; nothing shows on the shop until you start it.
xp.readOnly: You can see the tests. Writing, starting and ending them needs the permission to change A/B tests.
xp.moduleOff: The A/B tests switch is off: every visitor sees the shop as it is and nothing is counted.

fe.d: The module's switch and numbers. Off as the shop came: nothing is shown or counted.
fe.enabledHelp: On: a running test shows version B to its share of visitors and counts them. Off: everyone sees the shop as it is.
fe.confidenceHelp: How sure a result must be before a winner is offered (80–99).
fe.minVisitorsHelp: How many visitors each version needs before any result is shown.
fe.cookieDaysHelp: How long a new visitor keeps seeing the same version (his random id in the bag's cookie).
fe.readOnly: Only someone who may change A/B tests can change this.

xp.timeUp: Past its last day: B is not shown any more. End it to keep the result.
xp.goalLine: Counts who {goal} · B shown to {share}% of visitors · {until}

verdict.draft: Not started: nothing is shown or counted yet.
verdict.wait: Not enough visitors yet: each version needs {n}.
verdict.notSure: Not sure yet: {c}% of the {need}% needed.
verdict.b: B is better ({c}% sure). You can keep B.
verdict.a: A is better ({c}% sure): keep the shop as it is.
verdict.keptB: B was kept: its words and parts are now the shop's own.
verdict.keptA: A was kept: the shop stays as it was.
verdict.ended: Ended with no winner: the shop stays as it was.

xp.previewHelp: A preview link shows that version to whoever opens it, on every page until the browser is closed (add ?abPreview=off to stop); it is never counted.

stepAsk.keepB: Sure? Make B the shop's own
stepAsk.keepA: Sure? Keep the shop as it is

err.STALE: Someone changed this in between. The page was read again; please try once more.
err.MODULE_OFF: Turn the A/B tests switch on first (the card above).
err.CLASH: Another running test already changes the same thing: {fields}
err.NOT_DRAFT: This test has started, so it can no longer be changed.
err.NOT_ALLOWED: That step is not possible now.
err.NOT_SURE: The result is not sure enough for that yet.
err.forbidden: You may not do this. Needed: {fields}
err.other: Something went wrong. Please try again.

xp.notDraft: This test has started: what its visitors saw stays as it was. To try something else, write a new test.

f.name: Name
f.nameHelp: Your own name for the test, e.g. “Colour note on the product page”.
f.noteHelp: What you hope B does better; only for the team.
f.endsOnHelp: After this day B is no longer shown. Empty: until you end it.

xp.eyeH: Parts shown or hidden in B
xp.eyeHelp: Pick a part of a shop page and whether B shows or hides it. Parts about prices, offers, payment or delivery are not in the list.
xp.wordsHelp: Find a word of the shop and write what B says instead (English, Bengali or both). Words about money, numbers, offers, payment or delivery cannot be tested.
xp.wordFindPh: e.g. add to bag, size guide
xp.wordNone: No word found that can be tested.
xp.nothing: Add at least one part or one word for B.
